_doc: Room art config for `npm run web:rooms`. <Template>.png = background, <Template>-<item>.png = furniture drawn on the same canvas (its position on that canvas = default placement). Coordinates are fractions of the room size. heightCm = real height of the whole image so sprites stand at their real heights. Concrete: ceiling (image top) → floor where feet stand (≈0.969) = 300 cm → 300 / 0.969 ≈ 310.
